headline: ForecastGym separates search evidence, model reasoning, and memory in live-agent forecasting evaluation
summary: A November 17 preprint introduces ForecastGym, a protocol that prospectively captures search results for unresolved prediction-market questions and replays the frozen evidence to compare forecasting models, search providers and memory strategies under controlled conditions. The first reported batch contains 150 questions, 614 evidence states and 131,542 search results. In the authors' tests, rerunning queries after settlement leaked the outcome for up to 92% of questions despite date filters; all tested language models trailed market prices on the frozen evidence, and changing the search API shifted Gemini 3.8 Flash's last-state Brier score by up to 0.043, exceeding the 0.027 spread among four models. These are paper-reported findings from one sports-heavy batch and have not been independently reproduced; the provider effect bundles retrieval, follow-up queries and formatting.
